notes.title: VER 1.0.5 Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed grenade swtiching multiple times with one press.
-Small changes in player UI to make texts on same level.
-Turtortle no longer pushes player inside walls.
-Added some missing background tiles

notes.title: VER 1.0.4c Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed background in fourth level.
-Lifts in fourth level now kill when getting stuck under it.
-Added more bullets to be able be active at same time.

notes.title: VER 1.0.4b Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some sprites in third level.

notes.title: VER 1.0.4a Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Knowledge page some pictures were not in right place
-In space some small meteors were not visible
-Now saves on teleporting so progress is not lost when left planet at some points

notes.title: VER 1.0.4 Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed where you could skip Rocktorlord by jumping over it.
-Fixed where sometimes spaceship in levels had wrong sprite.
-Fixed where when buying player upgrades couldn't buy when cost amount
was same as player holding amount.


*Added content/changes:
-Space background completely changed in space station and space ship level.

notes.title: VER 1.0.3 Patch
notes.content:
*Bug Fixes:
-Fixed background tiles in hidden places at 3rd level that were on top of player.
-Fixed being able to throw a grenade when dying.

*Added content/changes:
-Lowered difficulty in 2nd level ice platforming
-Lowered difficulty in 3rd level meteor platforming.

notes.title: VER 1.0.2e Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some blocks in space station that were not passable.
-Light works better in underground water where needed.

*Added content/changes:
-Lowered sword barrier usage for base and each upgrade.

notes.title: VER 1.0.2d Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed small error that happened in space.

notes.title: VER 1.0.2c Patch
notes.content:
*Added content/changes:
-Added optional visible death counter that can be toggled on from settings.
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some minor UI Issues.
-Fixed getting two deaths instead of one when armor breaking and drowning at same time.

notes.title: VER 1.0.2b Patch
notes.content:
*Added content/changes:
-Lowered shotgun upgrade cost early for easier gameplay.

notes.title: VER 1.0.2a Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed lore menu pictures not being in right place on steamdeck

notes.title: VER 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed UI in main menu.
-Fixed when sometimes player spawned in space when starting space station level.

Added content/changes:
-Added new song to space.
-Added saving sound.

notes.title: VER 1.0.1d Patch
notes.content:
-Fixed UI elements not scaling enough. Now works on steamdeck.
-Fixed where sometimes grenades would be thrown two instead of one.

notes.title: VER 1.0.1c Hotfix
notes.content:
*Added content/changes:
-Changed some text to be easier to read and more grammatically correct.

notes.title: VER 1.0.1b Patch
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed where inventory or map didn't close from same button
-Text box buttons now easier to read
-In Upgrade UI navigation buttons advice was reversed and too small.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.1a Hotfix
notes.content: -Fixed where pressing continue in menu would prevent opening it again.

notes.title: Release Update VER 1.0.0
notes.content:
VER 1.0.0 Full Release
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed where changing music doesn't always work
-Some UI fixes in space
*Added content/changes:
-Added text to indicate death in space with longer animation.
-Added that cursor hides when using controller on menu and comes back when using keyboard
